dimensions.assessment: Affects residents and local jurisdictions within Bradford, Sullivan, Susquehanna, and Wyoming Counties in Pennsylvania.
dimensions.evidence: to consist of Bradford, Sullivan, Susquehanna, and Wyoming Counties, Pennsylvania

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a federal heritage area designation and requires submission of a management plan without imposing heavy mandates on private citizens.
dimensions.evidence: There is established as a component of the National Heritage Area System the Endless Mountains National Heritage Area

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal assistance through the Secretary of the Interior for the designated heritage area for a limited duration.
dimensions.evidence: the authority of the Secretary of the Interior to provide assistance under that section... shall terminate on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment

dimensions.assessment: Amends the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act to add a single new regional heritage area component.
dimensions.evidence: Section 6001(a) of the John D. Dingell, Jr. Conservation, Management, and Recreation Act... is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Provides federal assistance authority that terminates 15 years after enactment, alongside a 3-year deadline to submit a management plan.
dimensions.evidence: terminate on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts authorized for federal financial assistance to the heritage area.
importance_detail.rationale: Designates the Endless Mountains National Heritage Area in Pennsylvania, establishing a local coordinating entity and authorizing federal assistance for a 15-year period.
